title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1969-12-19
lineage: SBD > MR > C > D > CD + AUD low-gen

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a historic ‘69 show featuring the Dead’s first ad‑hoc acoustic set and tight electric numbers like Good Lovin' and Love Light
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this recording’s crystal‑clear, low‑hiss soundboard quality and celebrate the spontaneous acoustic mini‑set that opened the concert. The performance is highlighted by a Mason’s tease into “All Around This World,” a playful Wake Up Little Susie tease, and strong renditions of Good Lovin’ and Love Light, making it a must‑listen for ’69 enthusiasts.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews are glowing (5‑star) praising both the music and audio fidelity; only two anomalous 0‑star entries contain no negative criticism, so the combined show and recording quality merits a high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very little hiss, crisp mix; reviewers call the sound quality excellent.

show_quality.setlist_flow: An unexpected acoustic mini‑set opens the show due to Phil being stuck in traffic, followed by a solid electric set that keeps the momentum high.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Teases Wake Up Little Susie and admits he doesn’t know all the words; possibly plays pedal steel on some electric numbers.
band_member_comments.Phil: Late/stuck in traffic, prompting the ad‑hoc acoustic set; referenced as the “tall, skinny guy.”
